message: Workouts are more careful with what you enter. A number you're still typing is kept when you check off a set or save a routine, repeating a workout in a program no longer skips you a week, and finishing a workout with nothing done discards it instead of checking off its task. Imported CSV files with quotes or commas in their notes read correctly, and weights you describe for a pair of dumbbells follow your Dumbbell weights setting.
